# Xcortex

> Xcortex engineers AI software, intelligent automation and production systems that help companies understand more, automate more and move faster.

Xcortex is an AI software, automation and engineering agency. We build complete systems, not just models: software, data, integrations, workflows, infrastructure and interfaces, designed around a path to production.

## What we build

- Understand (Perception & RAG): systems that read, interpret, classify, search and reason across complex information. Document Intelligence, RAG, LLMs, Vision AI.
- Decide (Reasoning & Logic): AI systems that combine context, rules, models and business logic to produce reliable decisions. AI Agents, Decision Systems, Routing, BI.
- Act (Execution & Flow): autonomous workflows that connect intelligence to the tools and systems where work happens. AI Automation, Agentic Workflows, Tool Calling, APIs.
- Build (Full-Stack Systems): production-grade software engineered around your users, data, infrastructure and business. SaaS Platforms, Web Apps, Internal Tools, Cloud.
- Connect (Integration Layer): intelligence that works across the systems your business already uses. APIs, Databases, CRMs, Cloud Services.
- Evolve (Continuous Delivery): systems designed to be monitored, improved and extended over time. Observability, Evaluation, Optimization, CI/CD.

## Solutions

- Document Intelligence: turn unstructured documents into searchable knowledge, structured data and actionable information.
- AI Agents: systems that understand context, use tools, make decisions and complete multi-step tasks.
- Intelligent Automation: connect AI to existing workflows so repetitive operations can happen automatically.

## How engagements work

We do not start with a model. We start with the problem, design the system around it, then engineer the smallest reliable solution that can create real value.

1. Understand: map the problem, workflow, data, users, constraints and desired outcome.
2. Design: define the architecture, intelligence layer, integrations, data flow and system boundaries.
3. Engineer: build the software, AI components, automation, APIs and infrastructure required for production.
4. Evolve: test, evaluate, monitor, improve and extend the system as real usage creates new requirements.

To start, describe the problem you want to solve. Xcortex helps define the system, identify the highest-value opportunity and determine what should be built.
